note: The Vulkan driver's display offers 3840x2160, 2560x1440 and 1920x1080; each registers as its own VideoOut buffer set, presents at the display's rate and fills the screen; a size used again reuses its set.
must_contain: wsi/videoout: 1920x1080 framebuffers registered as set 2, buffers 10-14
Owner: each size filled the TV
Owner: RetroArch after the test steady, no flicker
human_check: The console's owner watched the run: each size filled the TV with the border on all four edges and the split centred, and RetroArch afterwards did not flicker.
